studyMetadata.title: Usefulness of Automatically Generated Genomics Visualizations
studyMetadata.description: Human evaluation of automatically generated genomics visualizations. Raters see a request, a preview of the input data and an interactive rendering, and score how usable the visualization is on a five-point scale.

uiConfig.studyEndMsg: Thank you. Your ratings have been recorded. If you had to stop early, whatever you completed is still usable. Please just let us know.

response.prompt: *Assume the request above faithfully states what the user wants. Judge only the visualization produced for it, not the request.*
How useful is this visualization for the request shown?
response.secondaryText: 3 is a real midpoint. Use it when you are undecided, not as a default. The last option is not part of the scale; pick it only if the interface itself failed and you could not see the visualization.

options.label: 3: Borderline
options.infoText: Could go either way. Use this when you are genuinely undecided.

options.label: 2: Major rework
options.infoText: Substantial work needed before it could be used.

options.label: 1: Unusable
options.infoText: Does not render, or is fundamentally wrong (wrong data, wrong encoding, misleading).

options.label: Cannot evaluate: technical problems with the interface
options.infoText: The page did not load, or nothing appeared at all. This is not a rating of the visualization.
